meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at Amo.1.1
§ Amos = "burden"
a prophet of the Lord who prophesied in the northern kingdom; native of Tekoa in Judah near Bethlehem and a shepherd by trade; author of the prophetic book by his name

elsewhere.note: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son…
